verdict.rationale: Poke's own docs show an official npm-distributed CLI (`npx poke@latest`) with login, tunnel, and mcp add subcommands, plus a --recipe flag that returns a recipe link and QR code in the terminal. The evidence consists of command snippets scattered across MCP and recipe docs rather than a dedicated CLI reference. Missing for 10: a comprehensive CLI reference covering all commands and options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: npx poke@latest tunnel http://localhost:3000/mcp -n "Local Dev MCP"
npx poke@latest mcp add https://mcp.example.com/sse -n "My Server"
With --recipe, the CLI creates a connection and returns a recipe link and QR code in the terminal.
